resources.string: Connect a camera with raw output to calculate the range.
Solid: current ROI · Dashed: suggested maximum. Tap to move.

Deselect calibration frames before changing the capture range.

The estimate covers accumulation, registration, tiled calibration/demosaicing, bounded previews and full-resolution export. Software Bin preserves the field of view and follows color reconstruction. The ceiling is 80% of the app heap; admission also reserves memory for existing objects and garbage collection. The 16.78 MP image limit and 32 MiB live raw-frame limit still apply. ROI alignment follows the camera controls.
